reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
The vendor's OpenAI-dialect reasoning replay contract must not be assumed for Anthropic Messages without a dialect-specific document or probe.

effortRequest.sourceRef: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/api/messages (.md rendering, read 2026-10-29) — MessagesRequest schema: `model` "This endpoint currently supports `kimi-k3.1-pro`, `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed`, and `kimi-k3`"; `output_config.effort`: enum low / high / max, default max, "Reasoning effort: low, high, or max; default max. Changing the level breaks prefix-cache hits, so decide it before the session starts." The request schema defines no `thinking` field (thinking appears only as response content blocks).

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/api/messages (read 2026-10-29): a response `thinking` block (`thinking`, `signature`) -- "In multi-turn conversations, pass the thinking block from the response (including `signature`) back unchanged inside the assistant message"; the `signature` field: "keep it unchanged when passing back". The Anthropic adapter replays the block verbatim on the producing model's next request. Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
